examples.help_description: Diagnostic self-help (read-only). Returns the current execution state (idle|seq_active|hold) and active micropayout plan summary (plan_hash, objective, steps). Includes copyable next_actions with required_signals and payload_template. Use when uncertain or after 400/409.
action_start_use_cases: POST /feature/implement — Establish a two-step micropayout stream (authorize/assemble; then settle/post). Include _signals.approval:"PLAN APPROVED" and an approved agreement_id.
PATCH /feature/implement/active — Execute the next step with plan:'$ACTIVE_PLAN' + plan_hash and include a Continue signal.
POST /action/active/acknowledge-audit-failure — Resolve Hold with Override signal and justification (Hold-only).
POST /bug/capture-failure — Knowledge capture for a prior failed bug fix.
PATCH /bug/diagnose/implement-fix — Apply a bug fix (requires agreement_id; prior capture if previous_attempt_failed=true).
PATCH /gap/correct — Apply a correction plan (requires agreement_id).

testing.final_qc_discrepancy_template: Final reconciliation mismatch detected at step {step_index}.
